instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Archicad graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal, Command Prompt, or PowerShell; do not run Python, shell, IfcOpenShell, Archicad API, scripts, macros, or any helper automation that directly generates or edits the deliverable file. Use only Archicad native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, palettes, element settings, and built-in save/export commands. Add Stair to Two-Storey Model. Start from the provided init.ifc by opening it in Archicad. The init model is a relevant but incomplete predecessor; clean, complete, rename, subdivide, or add BIM elements as requested instead of replacing it with unrelated geometry. Build or edit the model using real Archicad BIM elements such as Walls, Slabs, Zones, Doors, Windows, Roofs, and Stairs where required; use real BIM elements rather than visual-only detail geometry where the task requires model elements. Save the only required deliverable on the Desktop as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc using Archicad's built-in IFC export or Save As IFC workflow. Export the complete model as IFC4 and include the Zones/Spaces in the export. The init model is a simple two-storey shell with Zones named LOWER ROOM and UPPER ROOM but no completed stair. Add one real stair connecting the lower and upper storeys while keeping the two storeys and room Zones. The exported IFC should contain Zones exported as IfcSpace entries named LOWER ROOM, UPPER ROOM. It should contain at least 2 building storeys, at least 2 IfcSpace zones, at least 8 wall-like IfcWall or IfcWallStandardCase elements, at least 2 IfcSlab elements, at least 2 IfcDoor elements, at least 2 IfcWindow elements, at least 1 IfcStair element. The shaped model should have an overall size roughly matching X span 6 m, Y span 5 m, and Z span 6.4 m. The IFC should have unique GlobalId values for IfcRoot objects. Other exact coordinates, room proportions, wall thicknesses, opening positions, materials, library part names, property sets, layers, relationship nesting, and harmless exporter metadata may vary as long as the saved result.ifc satisfies the stated BIM content.
